unresolved_gaps: No matched liquidity and binding-payment analysis establishes an unavoidable financing shortfall for both companies under a slowdown.
No complete supplier-by-supplier sensitivity analysis establishes the claimed breadth of dependence.
The claim supplies no amount, duration or accounting basis for its resource requirement.
The evaluative debt and timing descriptions lack a reproducible test.
